__comment: The blocks an Electric Network pulls FE from as accumulators (ADR-0062). The tag, not the block's energy face, decides the role: a face that allows extraction is not enough, or any battery or machine would be drained. Oritech's Large Energy Storage is the accumulator (#283); a machine core resolves to its controller before the tag is asked, so only the controller is listed. A TagKey whose JSON is missing resolves to an empty tag silently, so the file ships rather than being absent.
